name: macedonian-corpus
title: Macedonian Corpus — metadata and annotated texts
description: Metadata and morphologically and syntactically annotated texts of the Macedonian Corpus. The metadata are in English; the material itself, and the names of people and titles, stay in Macedonian.

resources.name: speakers
resources.title: Speakers and authors
resources.description: One row per person whose language the corpus records.

fields.name: speaker_id
fields.description: Identifier used by texts.xlsx and by the annotation files.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name the person is known by, in Macedonian Cyrillic. For a writer this may be a pen name.

fields.name: birth_name
fields.description: The name on their papers, filled in only when it differs from name.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Recorded sex of the speaker.

fields.name: birth_year
fields.description: Year of birth.

fields.name: place_of_birth
fields.description: Settlement of birth, romanised. A second name the settlement goes by is kept in brackets.

fields.name: place_type
fields.description: Whether that settlement is a village or a town.

fields.name: municipality
fields.description: Municipality the settlement belongs to, romanised, when the source named one.

fields.name: dialect_region
fields.description: Dialect area the speaker comes from. Areas inside Macedonia are compass directions; speakers from elsewhere are given by country, with a part of it in brackets.

fields.name: education_level
fields.description: How far the speaker went in school.

fields.name: education_note
fields.description: What kind of school, when the source said so.

fields.name: religion
fields.description: Recorded religion.

fields.name: l1
fields.description: First language, as ISO 639-1 codes.

fields.name: l2
fields.description: Second language. Several codes are separated by a semicolon.

fields.name: l3
fields.description: Third language, written like l2.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Remarks the source hid inside cells that were meant to hold a value, such as postings as an ambassador.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: Row number in the spreadsheet this came from, for checking against the editors’ own copy.

resources.name: texts
resources.title: Texts
resources.description: One row per document of the corpus.

fields.name: text_id
fields.description: Identifier used by the annotation files: author surname, short title, year.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the text, in Macedonian Cyrillic.

fields.name: author_id
fields.description: The author, as a speaker_id.

fields.name: data_genre
fields.description: What kind of material this is.

fields.name: text_genre
fields.description: Literary genre. Several genres are separated by a semicolon.

fields.name: variety
fields.description: Whether the text is in the standard language or a dialect.

fields.name: variety_note
fields.description: What the source wrote beside the variety, romanised: which dialect, or why both are named.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year of publication. The first one, if several.

fields.name: year_note
fields.description: Further years the source gave, for a text published more than once.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Where the text can be read online.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Name of the file the editors delivered, kept as the record of where this row came from.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: Row number in the spreadsheet this came from.

resources.name: annotations
resources.title: Annotated texts
resources.description: One file per text, one row per token, in the order of the text. Morphology follows MULTEXT-East, syntax follows Universal Dependencies.

fields.name: text_id
fields.description: The text this token belongs to.

fields.name: sent_id
fields.description: Number of the sentence within the text.

fields.name: ud_id
fields.description: Position of the token within the sentence.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The word form as it stands in the text.

fields.name: diplomatic
fields.description: The word form in diplomatic transcription, where the corpus has one.

fields.name: lemma
fields.description: Dictionary form of the word.

fields.name: ud_pos
fields.description: Universal part-of-speech tag.

fields.name: pos_tag
fields.description: MULTEXT-East morphosyntactic description.

fields.name: pos_ext
fields.description: Universal Dependencies features.

fields.name: head
fields.description: The ud_id of this token’s syntactic head in the same sentence. 0 means the token is the root. The source called this column ud_valency, which it never was.

fields.name: ud_type
fields.description: Universal Dependencies relation to the head, subtypes included.

fields.name: speaker_id
fields.description: Who produced this stretch of language.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Timecode in the recording; only spoken material has one.
